Plots each control unit's weight and its own estimate

Source: R/plot.R
sdid_units_plot.Rd

Synthetic difference-in-differences estimates the effect as a weighted average, over the control units, of the difference-in-differences comparison of the treated units with each control alone, using the time weights. This plot shows those comparisons with their unit weights, for an estimate or each cohort of a staggered design.

Usage

sdid_units_plot(
  estimates,
  type = c("scatter", "bars"),
  cohort = NULL,
  label.units = NULL,
  weighted.only = FALSE
)

Arguments

estimates

The result of sdid(), or a named list of results with a single adoption period each, drawn in panels labeled by their names. A staggered result is drawn with a panel for each cohort, unless cohort chooses one.

type

The kind of plot. "scatter" (the default) plots each control's weight against its own estimate. "bars" draws a bar from the effect to each weighted control's own estimate, ordered by weight. See Details.

cohort

For a staggered result, the adoption period of the one cohort to plot, as it appears in the result's cohorts. Defaults to NULL, plotting every cohort in its own panel.

label.units

Which controls to label: "all", "weighted" (positive weight only), or a number n for the n largest weights. Defaults to "all" for one panel and 10 for several. The bars only show labeled controls.

weighted.only

TRUE to leave controls with no weight out of the scatter. Defaults to FALSE, drawing them as open circles.

Value

A ggplot object, which can be extended with +.

Details

type = "scatter" (the default) plots each control's weight against its own estimate, with the overall effect as a red line. Controls with zero weight are drawn as open circles. type = "bars" draws a bar from the effect to each weighted control's estimate, largest weight first; bars to the right pull the estimate up, bars to the left pull it down.

Requires ggplot2. If ggrepel is installed, it is used to keep labels from overlapping.
